title: Hospitality
definition: Hospitality is the loving welcome of others through generosity, care, service, and open-hearted kindness.
summary: Hospitality reflects God's welcome toward His people. It serves strangers, neighbors, believers, the needy, and the lonely with practical love.
christFocus: Christ welcomes sinners by grace and teaches His people to welcome others in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Hospitality reflects God's welcome toward His people. It serves strangers, neighbors, believers, the needy, and the lonely with practical love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
